definition: freightctl is a secure artifact exchange platform that lets agents, applications, people and systems send and receive artifacts under explicit permissions, with reliable delivery and traceable outcomes.
scope: Additional owner-approved product requirements. These are not incumbent capability observations or replacements for the original 83 parity rows and twelve complete customer journeys.

requirements.title: Participants can send and receive
requirements.requirement: Agents, applications, people and systems are scoped participants; a participant may send, receive or do both.
acceptance: Two separately authenticated agents exchange an exact artifact and a separately authorized reply with inference disabled.
Wrong-tenant, wrong-partner and unrelated participant discovery/retrieval are denied without metadata disclosure.

requirements.title: Immutable artifact custody
requirements.requirement: Artifacts bind exact revisions, length, digest, storage identity and provenance using existing durable custody and intake guards.
acceptance: Verify bytes independently and refuse changed revisions, incomplete uploads and mismatched integrity identities.
Required checks/approvals gate the exact bytes; held or unverified revisions cannot be retrieved or delivered after restart.

requirements.title: Approved endpoints and both exchange directions
requirements.requirement: Support push, permitted receive discovery/retrieval and governed source collection through explicitly qualified endpoint adapters.
acceptance: Exercise agent-to-agent and human/system-to-agent plus agent-to-system profiles; pin each actual adapter and role.
Refuse arbitrary addresses, unsafe path resolution and stale endpoint revisions; notifications convey no retrieval authority.

requirements.title: Permission for every handoff
requirements.requirement: Bind caller/delegation, artifact, recipient, policy and approvals; verify live authority for each consequential effect.
acceptance: Retrieval grants no forwarding or execution right; an unauthorized onward exchange is refused before external contact.
Stale approval, credential rotation/revocation and artifact-embedded instructions cannot change recipient, scope or privileges.

requirements.title: Honest lifecycle and receipts
requirements.requirement: Correlate acceptance, holds, availability, delivery, retrieval, integrity evidence and separately contracted processing outcomes.
acceptance: A notification, socket completion or byte receipt cannot claim receiver durability or business processing.
Redact status and lineage by participant authority; unavailable stronger evidence remains explicitly unknown.

requirements.title: Durable recovery and bounded execution
requirements.requirement: Use transactional events/intents/idempotency, bounded streams/queues, leases and fencing for recoverable exchanges.
acceptance: Same-key response-loss recovery preserves the original result; changed meaning under that key is refused.
Kill actual processes, retain acknowledged bytes and pending work, and expose ambiguous publication without unsafe resend or duplicate effects.
Prove admission, polling/notification and retry bounds without relaxing existing resources or isolation.

requirements.title: Shared surfaces and inference independence
requirements.requirement: UI, API, CLI and agent tools use the same domain services and authorization; participant exchange requires no freightctl model runtime.
acceptance: Exercise public interfaces and stock clients against real PostgreSQL/storage; no agent-only permission bypass or leaked transport secret.
Reference exchanges succeed with inference disabled; deterministic callers establish exchange behavior only, not actual AI quality.

requirements.title: External identity and optional Trust Control integration
requirements.requirement: Consume verified identities from configured sources; qualify an optional real Trust Control adapter while preserving independent core operation.
acceptance: Pin actual provider version, credential/issuer/audience/scope/delegation, expiry, rotation/revocation and outage behavior before integration claims.
Use the real approved provider to refuse wrong identity/authority and test queued/active rotation, revocation and fail-closed provider outage.
Repeat ordinary-provider exchange with Trust Control absent; a fixture cannot qualify real provider compatibility.

profiles.name: Bidirectional agent reference exchange
profiles.kind: engineering qualification profile; not a selected customer workflow
profiles.scope: One approved tenant/partner scope; wrong-scope refusals required. No general cross-tenant routing claim.
steps: Use real PostgreSQL, actual storage, a frozen ordinary identity profile and verified HTTPS with freightctl inference disabled.
A submits an immutable artifact to an approved B receive endpoint; required checks and approvals precede availability.
B discovers and retrieves only its authorized exact revision; a stock client/independent byte observer checks received bytes.
Refuse forwarding without permission; separately authorize B to send a new immutable reply to A.
Replay response loss, same-key recovery and changed meaning; revoke authority between notification and retrieval.
Kill actual processes at selected custody/delivery boundaries, verify retained acceptance and recheck pending-work authority; preserve ambiguous remote outcomes.

profiles.name: Human/system ingress and agent onward exchange
profiles.kind: engineering qualification profile; exact adapter pairs must be frozen
participants: Human using browser or ordinary client
External system using a stock protocol client or source
steps: Initial pair frozen:verified HTTPS resumable browser upload -> registered custody-https-poll-v1 receive view -> native authenticated download. Freeze remaining stock SFTP/FTPS push and governed collection/onward adapter-role pairs against existing protocol contracts;all remain mandatory. Governed source pair pinned:stock SFTP immutable ready-manifest collection -> governed-collection-exchange-source-v1 -> separately authorized custody-https-poll-v1 offer;actual full pair and remaining FTPS/onward outcomes owed.
A human and a system separately provide known artifacts to an agent receive endpoint, including a governed collection case.
The agent retrieves only approved revisions, then prepares a separately authorized onward exchange to a system endpoint.
Independently verify exact received bytes, current-policy refusals, per-hop evidence and inference-disabled behavior.
Exercise notification/retrieval revocation, endpoint change, interruption, idempotent recovery and ambiguous delivery; replay affected original journeys.

profiles.name: Optional real Trust Control identity provider
profiles.kind: provider interoperability profile; optional deployment dependency
profiles.prerequisite: X07: actual approved provider profile/access; no API or token format assumed.
steps: Pin real Trust Control provider/version and its credential verification, issuer/audience/scope/delegation and revocation/outage contract.
Authenticate separate participant identities and exercise a permitted exchange through ordinary freightctl services.
Refuse wrong issuer/audience/scope, expired/revoked credentials, excessive delegation and artifact-supplied authority before external effects.
Rotate/revoke identities during queued/active work and prove the frozen fail-closed behavior when the provider is unavailable.
Repeat the ordinary-provider reference exchange with Trust Control absent; inspect evidence for secret and cross-scope disclosure.

qualification_requirements: Bind every claimed pass to exact candidate/artifact identities, native environment, actual callers/receivers/providers, steps and safe hashed evidence.
Retain first failures, meaningful regression coverage, original-journey replay and remaining limits.
Fixtures, design documents, ledger checks, model answers and skips establish no runtime or real provider qualification.
Preserve original parity/journey/defect/evaluation records and separate assisted deployment, independent adoption and enterprise readiness.
execution: Active application implementation under S003; focused per-item proof, broad deferred qualification at FINISH. Resource and security limits unchanged.
